# Mujahid Abbas

> Mujahid Abbas is a freelance AI web and mobile app developer from Pakistan. He builds Laravel web platforms, Flutter mobile apps, custom SaaS products and WordPress/WooCommerce sites for clients worldwide.

## Key facts
- Role: AI web and mobile app developer (freelance, remote)
- Core stack: Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Flutter, REST APIs, WordPress, WooCommerce, Firebase
- Contact: WhatsApp +923219153891
